name: Orthographic Voxel Sprite Rendering
definition: A rendering technique that projects a 3D voxel model onto a 2D sprite plane using orthographic projection, rendering it as a flat billboard that appears identical from both eyes in VR to avoid per-eye pixel shimmer.
summary: Orthographic Voxel Sprite Rendering projects 3D voxels onto a 2D plane using head-centered parallel rays to eliminate VR per-eye shimmer, differing from sheet-buffered splatting by using a single fragment pass.
